questions: Are you currently in the hospital because you recently had surgery or another procedure involving your heart or chest?
Was your breastbone opened during that procedure?
Was the procedure performed because of a blocked heart artery or a heart attack?
Was a heart valve repaired or replaced?
Was a pacemaker or defibrillator implanted?
Have you had new or worsening chest pressure or pain since the procedure?
Are you currently short of breath?
Have you fainted or nearly fainted recently?
Have you had a new fast, irregular, or unusually slow heartbeat?
Have you had fever, chills, or increasing redness or drainage from the chest dressing?
Have you developed sudden weakness, numbness, trouble speaking, or trouble seeing?
Do you have severe pain that began suddenly and spreads to your back?
